steps.message: Open the file task.html in Downloads in the file manager; when prompted open it with Chrome. Then click the button 5 times, remember the numbers displayed, and enter their product in the form.

Execute: adb shell "ls -l /sdcard/Download /storage/emulated/0/Download 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; sed -n '1,260p' /sdcard/Download/task.html 2>/dev/null || sed -n '1,260p' /storage/emulated/0/Download/task.html 2>/dev/null"
